description: Change one of the user's own job alerts by alertId: pause or resume it, daily or weekly, its location, and its filters (work mode, job type, level, minimum annual pay + currency). Send only the fields to change; an empty string clears a filter or the location. Answers the alert as stored, how many live jobs added in the last 7 days match it now and up to 3 of them.

location.description: City, region or country; empty = no place.

name: update_job_alert
title: Change a job alert
